title: Moon Knight #2 #3 #4 Lot Marvel 2006 Charlie Huston David Finch The Bottom
conditionDescription: All three bright with light handling wear; #2 has light wear on the back cover; #3 light edge and corner wear; #4 a small chip at the top right corner of the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Moon Knight #2, #3 and #4 (2006), Marvel Comics - volume 5, The Bottom parts 2-4. Charlie Huston story, David Finch covers and art, Danny Miki inks, Frank D'Armata colors. Direct editions, Parental Advisory, $2.99 cover price each.

- #2: Moon Knight in the rain cover; back cover X-Men: The Official Game (Activision) ad
- #3: back cover X-Men: The Official Game (Activision) ad
- #4: Bushman on the throne cover; back cover Who Wants to Be a Superhero? (Sci Fi Channel) ad

Condition: all three bright with light handling wear; #2 light wear on the back cover, #3 light edge and corner wear, #4 a small chip at the top right corner of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
